name: @bookskill/desktop
description: BookSkill Desktop application shell. Original BookSkill UI and navigation; not a repackaged AnythingLLM desktop binary.
author: BookSkill

scripts.test: pnpm --filter @bookskill/repo-baseline build && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && node --test --test-reporter=spec test/*.test.ts
scripts.smoke: pnpm build && node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs && node scripts/smoke.mjs
scripts.pack:dir: pnpm build && node scripts/ensure-electron.mjs && node scripts/pack-dir.mjs
